services.name: Custom Charter
services.desc: Being that SeaSalt Charters offer private charter services, we ultimately want to leave it up to the customer what he or she would like to do in order to get the most out of their experience. Basically every trip at any time is a custom charter. However, if there is something specific you would like to plan out before booking your trip, just bring it up and we will work together to get you what you want. Imagine a whole day spent doing every sort of Cape Cod water activity thinkable. blurb: SeaSalt Charters offers private whale watching and fishing charters on a comfortable boat for up to 6 guests. Trips explore the whales' feeding and nursing grounds of Stellwagen Bank near Provincetown, MA. Experienced licensed captains provide a memorable and meaningful experience adhering to NOAA Northeast whale watching guidelines.
extraNote: Adheres to NOAA Northeast whale watching guidelines · Dolphin Fleet dock in Provincetown, MA
